title: The Whispers of Our Voice (Standard (F4F))
description: A remix of an older hypnosis file and series; this new bonus loop is now available, combining all the whisper tracks from the "The Two Sides" mini-series! One distinct main track, which is predominately from "Sleight of Voice" and "Irresistible Illusion", forms the base audio, around which all of the whispered subliminal layers will come in from different angles to teasingly tempt and pull at your attention. You can’t fight it. You can’t escape it. The longer you listen, and better focused you train — The stronger my rewards will feel. Do you still believe in Fate? The choice I'll offer you this time is simple. But you won’t be any the wiser, to all of the social tricks and triggers I'm going to pick out from my arsenal. So let me take you then, on a little journey, one of self discovery ... As I play with your mind. Your conscious mind that will listen to me over here, while I tinker with the subconscious, embedding my staple triggers deeper and deeper inside of you. Fate is just an illusion — An irresistible illusion. And under the right circumstances? It can feel really really good.
author: Mistress Shibby
